claim_title: Women with ADHD have early onset of perimenopausal symptoms
caption: **ADHD and earlier perimenopausal symptoms.** One large Icelandic study found women with ADHD reported more severe menopausal symptoms, peaking around age 35–39 versus 45–49 in women without ADHD. But the "10 years earlier" figure comes from a descriptive snapshot rather than a formal statistical test, and the symptom scale overlaps heavily with ADHD-related mood, sleep, and fatigue — so it can't cleanly separate earlier menopause from simply higher symptom scores at all ages.
subtitle: One large study supports the link, though the symptom measure overlaps with ADHD itself.
